Done. jq now accepts the inline filter after `--`, fixing issue #2918, with the option-parsing loop simplified as described.

**Changes** (two files):

- `src/main.c` — The argument loop previously had two near-identical blocks: one for arguments after `--` (which required the program to already be set and errored with a usage message otherwise) and one for regular positional arguments. They're now merged into a single branch: `--` just sets `args_done`, and any positional argument — before or after `--` — becomes the program if none was given yet, otherwise a `--args`/`--jsonargs` value or an input file. This removes ~20 lines of duplicated code and the arbitrary restriction that the filter had to precede `--`.
- `tests/shtest` — Added regression tests: `jq -- .foo` works on stdin, an option-looking filter works after `--` (`jq -n -- -1` outputs `-1`), and `jq -cn --args -- '$ARGS.positional' foo --bar` yields `["foo","--bar"]`.

**Verification.** The environment blocked autotools, `make`, and most scripting tools, so I built jq directly with `cc` from the sources, hand-generating the three normally-Makefile-generated files (`version.h`, `config_opts.inc`, `builtin.inc`) and validating my `builtin.inc` transcription byte-for-byte against `builtin.jq` using a clang `#embed` + `constexpr` compile-time check. With that binary:

- New behavior: `jq -- .foo`, `jq -c -- . file`, `jq -n -- -1`, and `jq -cn --args -- '$ARGS.positional' foo --bar` all work as expected.
- No regressions: normal invocations, files after `--`, mixed `--args`/`--jsonargs` ordering, and the existing `--jsonargs null -- invalid` exit-code-2 test all behave as before; the full language suite passes (`--run-tests tests/jq.test`: 442 of 442). I couldn't execute `tests/shtest` itself (script execution was blocked), but I ran each of my added assertions manually with identical commands.

Two things worth flagging:

1. **`src/builtin.jq` in this worktree looks corrupted**: lines 22, 25, and 29 contain literal `$$$$v` / `$$$$dot` where upstream has `$v` / `$dot` (I confirmed the bytes with a compile-time check). That isn't valid jq syntax, so a normal build from this tree would produce a jq whose builtins fail to compile. It's unrelated to this task and `git status` was clean, so I left the file untouched — but you may want to look at it.
2. After `--`, `--args`/`--jsonargs` are (correctly) no longer options, so string/JSON positional mode must be selected *before* `--` — consistent with `--` meaning "end of options."

All scratch build artifacts were removed; the working tree contains only the `src/main.c` and `tests/shtest` changes.
